item.title: Six months on, U.S. Navy families who evacuated Bahrain remain in limbo
item.description: When the U.S.-Iran war began, more than 1,000 dependents of U.S. Navy personnel in Bahrain were ordered to evacuate. After six months in temporary conditions, they want to know what the plan is.
item.content:encoded:
When the U.S.-Iran war began, more than 1,000 dependents of U.S. Navy personnel in Bahrain were ordered to evacuate. After six months in temporary conditions, they want to know what the plan is.

(Image credit: U.S. Navy)

item.title: Penn State bust put focus on cocaine but on most campuses the big risk is alcohol
item.description: A drug bust involving an alleged cocaine ring at Penn State has drawn attention to drug use on college campuses, but research shows the big risk to students is alcohol.
item.content:encoded: A drug bust involving an alleged cocaine ring at Penn State has drawn attention to drug use on college campuses, but research shows the big risk to students is alcohol.

item.title: Supreme Court pauses lower court ruling on Trump's mail voting order as hurdles loom
item.description: The Supreme Court paused a lower court's ruling that blocked key parts of Trump's order to limit voting by mail for the midterms. But U.S. Postal Service work on the order remains blocked nationwide.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Sean Grayson, former deputy convicted of killing Sonya Massey, dies in prison, lawyer says
item.description: Sean Grayson, a former Illinois sheriff's deputy whose fatal shooting of Sonya Massey inside her home became a flashpoint over police use of force, died Sunday while serving a 20-year prison sentence.
